title: Calculations on reactions - 123 school
heading: Calculations on reactions
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
If the question does not say how to round, round to one decimal place.

questions.q: What does the law of conservation of mass state?
questions.a: The total mass before the reaction is equal to the total mass after the reaction

questions.q: In a reaction in a closed bottle, 12 g of magnesium reacts with 8 g of oxygen. How many grams of magnesium oxide are formed?
When 10.0 g of limestone (CaCO<sub>3</sub>) is heated, 5.6 g of calcium oxide and carbon dioxide are formed. How many grams of carbon dioxide are formed?
You burn steel wool in the open air. The mass increases. Why is that?
questions.a: The steel wool takes up oxygen from the air

questions.q: A candle burns in the open air and the mass decreases. Why is that?
questions.a: The gases formed, carbon dioxide and water vapour, escape into the air

In the reaction 2 Mg + O<sub>2</sub> → 2 MgO, 0.50 mol of Mg reacts. How many moles of MgO are formed?
What does a molar mass of 18 g/mol mean for water?
questions.a: One mole of water has a mass of 18 g

questions.q: What is the mass of 2.0 mol of CO<sub>2</sub>? Molar mass of CO<sub>2</sub> = 44 g/mol.
What can you read from 2 H<sub>2</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → 2 H<sub>2</sub>O?
questions.a: 2 mol of H<sub>2</sub> reacts with 1 mol of O<sub>2</sub> to form 2 mol of H<sub>2</sub>O
